evaluation.overall_comment: The translation effectively captures the podcast's educational dialogue and conveys the core scientific narrative to a Lao-speaking audience. Removing the note and applying correct technical terminology would elevate this to a high-quality, publication-ready translation suitable for science communication in Lao.
